svg.text: The newest layers: inverses and the integer grading, the program algebra, the periodicity spectrum

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SignedWords: a relation letter may be run backwards, as an inverse property path. The degree of a signed word is exactly

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the metaclass-level displacement it performs (Ontology.level_add_sdegree), so a forward and a backward instance of step

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cancel: an honest integer grading. A closed signed walk has degree zero, hence a closing word of non-zero degree refutes

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every ontology model of the base.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ProgramAlgebra, CyclicAlgebra and CompilerPipeline: the transformations of the ontology layer read as programs - a Godel

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: numbering of the relation words (RelWord.equivNat), their composition monoid (KB.wordStep_append), the compiler stages

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: acting by morphisms, the ZMod d phases, and the order-exactly-twelve cyclic part, split by the CRT into its prime fibres

DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Periodicity, PeriodicityReport, SpectrumReport and FeedbackSets: the search for periodic points, run over the whole

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: downloaded corpus. Eleven items of the class hierarchy are periodic, the remaining 1567 are not, a phase certificate makes

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the period of each of the four components exact, and the minimum feedback sets measure the distance to acyclicity.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The category-theoretic layer: ontologies with their limits and colimits, the pullback as a fibre product of spaces, the

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: symmetries and the GF(2) vector space of class extensions, a Grothendieck topology whose covering families are stable

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under pullback, labellings as a sheaf on that site, and the pullback again as a homotopy fibre product.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Publish, Sync and Archive: the findings leave the repository under proof - a JSON Lines record of a knowledge base parses

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back to exactly what was written, its content address identifies it, peer-to-peer gossip converges to one state that loses

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nothing and invents nothing, and an archive deposit re-imports to the ontology it was made from.

svg.text: Enrichment, CorpusFrontier and CorpusRounds: the loop that grows the corpus from its own sources - pull every Wikimedia

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: page of an item, scan the articles and what they cite, rank what is missing, absorb the most referenced of it - with the

svg.text: frontier shrinking 144, 70, 42, 18, 14 and every round proved to lose nothing.
